laiDetails.initiationProtocol: First injection 400 mg gluteal/deltoid plus 14 days oral aripiprazole 10-20 mg/day. Maintenance 400 mg monthly (300 mg if intolerable or strong CYP3A4/2D6 inhibitor co-prescribed).

halfLife.notes: Effective half-life ~30-46 days. Steady state reached after 4-5 monthly injections. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: Dehydro-aripiprazole
activeMetabolite.notes: Same active metabolite as oral aripiprazole. Combined long half-life enables monthly dosing. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Strong CYP2D6 (paroxetine, fluoxetine) or CYP3A4 (clarithromycin, ketoconazole) inhibitors raise levels — reduce LAI dose to 300 mg if combined for >14 days. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: Among the most metabolically neutral LAIs. Frequently chosen when escaping olanzapine. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Akathisia rather than relapse is the dominant switch concern. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Pre-filled dual-chamber syringe. Cannot be split. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
